summary: Shows realistic module_defaults uses: shared basic auth credentials for uri calls and a default AWS region for several EC2 modules.
questions: How do I avoid repeating auth credentials on every uri task?
How do I set a default AWS region for EC2 modules?

answer_card.title: module_defaults for API auth and AWS region
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
module_defaults:
  ansible.builtin.uri:
    force_basic_auth: true
    user: some_user
    password: some_password
```

```yaml
module_defaults:
  amazon.aws.ec2:
    region: '{{ my_region }}'
  community.aws.ec2_instance_info:
    region: '{{ my_region }}'
```
